Gen 7 prototype: policy net cloned from Gen 6, and the Gen 6 search reading it

Net (bridge_harness/gen7_net.py, 258,434 parameters): from one seat's view it
predicts the card Gen 6 played and Gen 6's estimated cost of every legal card.
The auction reaches it as the raw calls and as what the hand-fit scorer says
each seat's calls show, routed per suit. Trained on 3,355 deals from the Gen 6
feeds; 61% exact-card agreement on test deals, an equal-best card in its top 3
97% of the time. It should not pick cards; it is a candidate generator.

Player (bridge_harness/gen7.py): Gen6Player plus three switches that read the
net: play-likelihood layout weights from the deal list on, net tie-break, and
unsearched early tricks for fast data tables. Switches off, it plays Gen 6's
game card for card.

Checks (scripts/gen7_check.py) on held-out deals: the local Gen 6 reproduces
the live bot's recorded estimates; play weights add 0.30 nats to the true
layout's log-probability with no measurable change in card quality at tricks
7+; 40-board match +0.30 IMPs/board +- 0.21 (no evidence of a difference).

Nothing here changes Gen 6 or the collectors. See
docs/gen7_prototype_2026-11-11.md.
